categories.main_business_segments: SLB operates through four main business segments: Digital & Integration, Reservoir Performance, Well Construction, and Production Systems. Each division integrates specialized technologies and services to address different stages of the energy value chain, from digital solutions and reservoir evaluation to well construction and production systems. These segments are supported by a global network of R&D centers and are organized geographically into four Basins: Americas Land, Offshore Atlantic, Middle East & North Africa, and Asia.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: SLB leverages advanced digital platforms (including AI, machine learning, and cloud-based solutions), proprietary and open-source data technologies, and industry-leading simulators. Its production methods include integrated drilling and measurement systems, engineered drilling fluids, advanced well construction and cementing, artificial lift, subsea and surface equipment, and innovative reservoir stimulation and intervention techniques. The company also invests in new energy technologies such as carbon capture, hydrogen, geothermal, stationary energy storage, and critical minerals extraction.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SLB's primary customers are national oil companies, large integrated oil companies, and independent operators in the oil and gas sector. The company also increasingly serves customers in emerging low- and zero-carbon energy markets, including those seeking digital transformation and decarbonization solutions. No single customer accounts for more than 10% of consolidated revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: SLB has a global presence in more than 100 countries, with significant operations in North America, Latin America, Europe/CIS/Africa, and Middle East & Asia. In 2022, approximately 84% of revenue was generated outside the United States, with key growth regions including the Middle East, Latin America, and offshore basins worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: SLB primarily operates as a technology and service provider in the upstream segment of the energy supply chain, supporting exploration, development, and production of oil and gas. Through its Production Systems division, it also serves midstream and downstream markets with equipment and processing solutions, and is expanding into adjacent new energy supply chains.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: SLB's strategy centers on driving energy innovation for a balanced planet, with a focus on strengthening its core oil and gas business, expanding digital and decarbonization offerings, and investing in new energy technologies. R&D priorities include digital transformation (notably the DELFI platform), emissions reduction (Transition Technologies and SEES methane elimination), and scaling solutions in carbon capture, hydrogen, geothermal, energy storage, and critical minerals. The company is committed to a 2050 net-zero GHG emissions target, with interim milestones for 2025 and 2030.
categories.revenue_model: SLB generates revenue primarily through the sale of services and products, including digital solutions, equipment, and integrated project management. Revenue streams include short-term service contracts, long-term construction-type contracts, software licensing, software-as-a-service (SaaS) subscriptions, and performance-based compensation (e.g., fee-per-barrel or cash flow sharing in Asset Performance Solutions).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SLB is positioned as a global technology leader in the energy services industry, competing with other major oilfield service companies such as Halliburton and Baker Hughes, as well as numerous regional and specialized firms. The company differentiates itself through technological innovation, digital leadership, and a growing portfolio of low-carbon and new energy solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, SLB reported revenue of $28.1 billion, a 23% increase year-over-year, with all divisions and regions experiencing double-digit growth. The company achieved a pretax operating margin of 18% and net income of $3.5 billion. SLB maintains a strong balance sheet, with $2.9 billion in cash and short-term investments and a net debt of $9.3 billion at year-end, and is positioned for continued growth in both traditional and new energy markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SLB delivers unique value through its integrated technology portfolio, digital innovation, and commitment to sustainability. The company emphasizes performance improvement, cost and emissions reduction, and tailored solutions for diverse regional markets. Its leadership in digital transformation, emissions quantification, and new energy technologies positions SLB as a partner of choice for customers navigating the energy transition.
